How to get a GitHub token
GitHub Issue Finder needs a free GitHub personal access token to search for issues. It only reads public information, so your token needs no permissions at all.
Sign in at github.com. You can create a free account if you don\'t have one.
Open Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic), then choose Generate new token (classic). The button below takes you straight there.
Name it \"GitHub Issue Finder\" and pick an expiration. Leave every permission (scope) unchecked.
Tap Generate token, then copy the token. GitHub shows it only once, so copy it before leaving the page.
Come back here, paste it into the token box, and tap Save.
Your token stays on this device and is sent only to GitHub. A token saved here replaces any token built into the app.
Using the token built into this app. Enter your own below to replace it.
